name: strata-workflow
description: Strata — built on Claude Code's dynamic Workflows + ultracode: model-tiered, budget-bounded, multi-mode agent orchestration.

plugins.name: strata-workflow
plugins.description: Built on dynamic Workflows + ultracode — structured multi-agent fan-out (focus / review / sweep / panel / debate / research / scale (+rounds) / ultra (+emergent) / delegate / conduct / debug + audit) that caps agent count, reserves opus for a thin plan/advise/judge/audit layer, and spend-gates the fable apex behind delegate's escalation ladder and conduct's two orchestration endpoints. Same orchestration power, a fraction of the token burn.

plugins.name: strata-assist
plugins.description: Optional companion mod for Strata (interactive Claude Code only): a live band that explains how a /strata-workflow command parses (mode, domain, cap, agents≈) and a Jev (TypeSafe) predicted auto-route. Strata itself runs unchanged without it.
